{\scriptsize\raggedright
\textit{Population:} BASE (iteration-0 artifacts of the base cells); E01/E04: ENH\_PAIRS(BASE). \textit{Unit:} artifact (base cell); E01/E04: enhanced pair.
\textit{CI:} 95\% CI: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, percentile intervals, stratified by block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full\_ext among its 48); seed 20261017; cluster = benchmark; 2,000 replicates (descriptive, unadjusted).
Block: full\_ext.
Cells: percentage (numerator/denominator); E01 and E04 count enhanced pairs, E02/F01/F02 base cells; F01/F02 DIRTY = \textgreater{}= 1 reported blocking finding of an applicable tool (union over tools, labelled as such).
Denominator exclusions (methodology missingness rules; JSON key excluded): no unit is excluded in this table by E02 (artifact(s) without a valid pair (counted separately)).
REASONING: Reasoning settings differ between models and are not equalised (see the closure disclosure register, item reasoning\_policy\_differences); some providers report no reasoning-token field.
IC2: E02 is not an independent confirmation of Q06 gains: it counts build failures, and most E02 improvements are the same cells as the Q06 improvements; the held-out signal proper is the joint transition X06 (e.g. Q06 repaired but E02 still failing) and G01.
IC4: DIRTY means at least one finding the frozen tool configuration marks blocking (dominated by clang-tidy bugprone heuristics, see X03), not a confirmed defect; under the frozen rule findings of entries in analysis-gap states count (sensitivity X02).
\textit{Definitions} (methodology; full text in the JSON form of this table): BASE; ENH\_PAIRS; E01 enhanced\_pair\_pass; E02 enhanced\_all\_pass; E04 enhanced\_gated\_share; F01 static\_verdict\_three\_state; F02 dynamic\_verdict\_three\_state.\par
\textsuperscript{b}~--: not estimated at this stratification (the producer computes F01/F02 per model and per execution model, not per model x execution model)\par
